content: Alibaba Cloud's official Python SDK core library is 'aliyun-python-sdk-core' on PyPI (Python3: aliyun-python-sdk-core-v3 historically, current releases support py3.7-3.12); source github.com/aliyun/aliyun-openapi-python-sdk. A newer v2.0 SDK exists at github.com/aliyun/alibabacloud-python-sdk.
